chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Hopkins band film shorts and Fred Norman's arrangement
summary: Movie shorts with the band and the Step Brothers; Fred Norman arranges Blue Memories for Mosley.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Oh, sure. See, they made a picture just before I joined the band--
Yeah, I know; I have the short. I got that at home, in the barbershop. Barbershop Blues.
The guys that were dancing in that was the Step Brothers, I think.
The Step Brothers? Well maybe, yeah.
Tip, Tap and Toe were in another one.
Yeah, they were in the one where the band had changed.
Yeah, I got that on tape.
I think I have that, yeah.
I never made a movie with Claude, but we did "Blue Memories."
Fred Norman made all the arrangements.
Fred Norman made the beautiful arrangement.
That's how I was introduced in Claude's band. He was very kind to me.
Fred Normal was just a perfect prince. Fred Norman made the arrangements on "Blue Memories."
